mr. mcquaid stated i am an architect and i work with civil engineers on projects all over the state and this is quite small. it's being handled quite well in my professional experience so i feel i can speak to the size of the project and how it's being handled. mr. resnikavitch asked what is big to you. mr. alonzo stated this is not a useful conversation, we have something before us and and i agree wita mir. mcquaid that have enough complaints. everything has been addressed, so i am against continuing the hearing. we are talking about an area that has no blasting or rock crushing on site. i don't know what further information the members of this board think they are going to get additionally that is going to sway their opinion. mr. jeffreys stated he heard what mr. mcquaid was saying. i can relate to where the applicant is coming from on this. we have to be thoughtful in our decisions and i think that what is being asked if that we wait two more weeks to write better conditions. mr. mcquaid asked why can't we write them tonight? ms. adams stated she wanted to hear from the building commissioner. mr. proctor stated mr. rhodes enlightened everyone because he went out and found violations. typical protocol for an earth removal permit is not getting the opinion of the the building inspector. he goes out and inspects after the project is approved and at renewal time. there are no deficiencies in this plan because it hasn't started yet. mr. smith asked what would be the hours of operation. mr. jeffreys withdrew his motion. further discussion en
